metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Mina Fogbrush
records.biography_en: Mina Fogbrush joins The Weather Maintenance Office as fog sweeper. “A bit of fog in the dustpan.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short hand broom gathering one soft puff of fog.

records.name: Perry Hailsort
records.biography_en: Perry Hailsort joins The Weather Maintenance Office as hail sorter. “Six fits. Seven is weather.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny open egg carton with a few round hailstones.

records.name: Hal Windsock
records.biography_en: Hal Windsock joins The Weather Maintenance Office as wind surveyor. “The wind is ignoring the form.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short windsock bent the wrong way on a stubby pole.

records.name: Tess Rainseal
records.biography_en: Tess Rainseal joins The Weather Maintenance Office as rain dispatcher. “Close the showers for lunch.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small umbrella-shaped shutoff valve.

records.name: Sid Pressure
records.biography_en: Sid Pressure joins The Weather Maintenance Office as barometer attendant. “The needle is in a mood.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: large single-dial barometer with clear glass.

records.name: Gus Cloudtest
records.biography_en: Gus Cloudtest joins The Weather Maintenance Office as cloud quality inspector. “It passed in the morning.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one soft miniature cloud with a shallow dent.
